interface.shortDescription: Give Codex a team of external co-engineers without giving up control.
interface.longDescription: Give Codex a team of external co-engineers without giving up control. Codex remains chief engineer, reviewer, and merge authority. Delegating to Co-Engineer starts one bounded run. Chatting with Co-Engineer inspects, continues, answers grouped attention, or cancels that existing run. Public provider names are Using Grok Co-Engineer, Using Cursor Co-Engineer, and Using Muse Co-Engineer. The honest shape is up to eight isolated external co-engineers, one bounded run, one coordinated wait, one verified decision.
